about.label: About
about.bio: 4+ years of professional experience building microservice backends with C# and ASP.NET Core, enterprise systems for logistics and car rental, websites for business clients, and iOS apps with Swift. Focused on distributed systems, AI integrations, and clean code.
about.education: Gebze Technical University - Computer Engineering (B.Sc.), 2021 - Feb 2026

bullets: Built responsive websites, back-office (admin) panels, and a mobile app for business clients, along with SEO work to grow organic traffic.
Built RESTful APIs in the microservice backend of the BMW/MINI/Land Rover rental platform; CQRS, RabbitMQ, Redis, JWT.
SAP integration with Quartz.NET; versioned BFF endpoints for web and admin; MongoDB, Docker, Azure DevOps.
Full-stack .NET development for logistics operations: built shipment and partial-load tracking, warehouse, and order management modules end to end (ASP.NET Core + EF Core backend, web interfaces).
Monitoring and reporting screens for shipment statuses and RESTful API integrations; query and performance improvements on MSSQL.
Built an internal project management platform in a 6-person team (ASP.NET MVC, EF Core), and added a semantic search module for natural-language search over documents (embedding + vector DB).
